annotate_screenshot.summary: Screenshot with red boxes around specified elements.

apply_probe_tool.summary: Apply one revelation probe (expand menu, scroll, access key, etc.).

ascii_ui_view.summary: Render the target window as a simplified ASCII map (UI 'eye' for agents).

attach_to_app.summary: Attach to a running process by name. Returns app_id for scoped tools.

attach_to_pid.summary: Attach to a running process by PID. Returns app_id.

batch_actions.summary: Execute a sequence of input actions and optionally return one screenshot.

build_detection_context.summary: Rich agentic context: screenshot, tree, OCR dual, visual regions, suggestions.

check_java_bridge.summary: Check Java Access Bridge prerequisites for Swing/AWT automation.

check_session_status.summary: Report session health: target alive, locked desktop, minimized, operations.

check_version.summary: Check whether a newer AwdUI version is available on GitHub.

click_element.summary: Find a UI element and click its center (or clickable point).

click_element_hwnd.summary: Click element scoped to a specific HWND.

click_text.summary: Find text on screen using OCR and click it. Fallback when accessibility can't find the element.

clipboard.summary: Read from or write to the system clipboard.

close_app.summary: Close application registered under app_id and remove session.

compare_screenshot_files.summary: Pixel diff between two screenshot files .

configure_uac.summary: Manage Windows UAC consent prompts. Requires user permission upfront.

detect_framework.summary: Detect the UI framework of a window and get automation hints.

detect_visual_regions.summary: Detect clickable UI regions via OpenCV + OCR (for opaque apps).

detection_health.summary: Report which detection backends are available and element counts.

discover_control_interaction.summary: Recommend MCP tools and steps from UIA role/patterns (generic, any app).

discover_target_tool.summary: Methodical discovery loop: observe → resolve → plan → apply probes until found.

double_click_element.summary: Double-click a UIA element by automation_id or name.

drag.summary: Drag from one position to another.

drag_element.summary: Drag from source element to target element (center to center).

element_at_point.summary: Get the UI element at screen coordinates (like Automation Spy pick).

element_exists.summary: Single-shot check whether a control exists (no polling).

expand_collapse_element.summary: Expand, collapse, or toggle an ExpandCollapse control.

expand_element.summary: Expand or collapse via ExpandCollapsePattern; fallback_click for UWP SettingsExpander.

fill_form.summary: Fill multiple form fields in one call (AutomationId or Name per field).

find_all_elements.summary: List all matching elements with index (for disambiguating duplicates).

find_by_template_tool.summary: Find UI element by template image (icon/button screenshot).

find_element.summary: Find a UI element by name, role, automation_id, or class_name.

find_elements.summary: Search UIA elements with substring filters (Extended UIA).

find_elements_fuzzy.summary: Fuzzy UIA search tolerating typos and partial names.

find_item_by_property.summary: Find a child item in a list/tree via ItemContainer.FindItemByProperty (subtree fallback).

find_text.summary: Find text on screen using OCR. Use when accessibility targeting can't find an element.

focus_window.summary: Find a window by partial title and focus, minimize, maximize, or restore it.

get_all_values.summary: Read all editable fields (Edit, ComboBox, CheckBox, etc.) in the window.

get_element_bounds.summary: Return bounding box of a UIA element.

get_element_properties.summary: Get full UIA properties for an element (Automation Spy style inspector).

get_event_log.summary: Return captured UIA monitor events for a session.

get_focused_element.summary: Get the currently focused UI element.

get_grid_item.summary: Get a grid/table cell by row and column index (UIA GridPattern or DevExpress cells).

get_mouse_position.summary: Get the current mouse cursor position.

get_notifications.summary: Get new windows/dialogs/toasts detected since the watcher started.

get_screen_size.summary: Get the dimensions of all connected monitors.

get_server_info.summary: Returns MCP server version, runtime info, and whether a newer release is available on GitHub.

get_snapshot.summary: Compact UI tree snapshot (like browser DOM) for a window or HWND modal.

get_snapshot_hwnd.summary: Compact UIA snapshot scoped to HWND.

get_target_window.summary: Get the current target window and focus policy.

get_tree_hash.summary: Hash of visible UIA tree for change detection.

highlight_element.summary: Highlight an element on screen with a red border (Automation Spy style).

hover.summary: Move the mouse cursor to a position without clicking. Useful for revealing tooltips.

invalidate_cache.summary: Clear UIA caches after relaunch, Calculator mode switch, or stale element reads.

invoke_element.summary: Invoke a button/menu via UIA patterns (Invoke, SelectionItem, Toggle, Expand).

launch_app.summary: Launch an application (reuses existing instance by default).

list_apps.summary: List app_id sessions created by attach_to_app / attach_to_pid.

list_control_items.summary: List items under a ComboBox, List, or grid (paginated, scoped subtree).

list_desktop_windows.summary: List top-level windows with HWND, title, PID, and geometry.

list_elements.summary: List accessible UI elements in a window.

list_windows.summary: List visible windows; optional app_id filters to that session's process.

manage_screenshots.summary: Manage saved screenshots: list, cleanup, or change the rolling cap.

observe_ui_tool.summary: Structured UI observation snapshot (framework, tree, modals, fingerprint).

plan_probes_tool.summary: Ranked list of revelation probes with reasons (methodical, not random).

press_key.summary: Press a single key (RETURN, TAB, ESCAPE, F5, etc.).

read_element.summary: Read properties of a UI element (by automation_id/name; optional index).

read_element_by_index.summary: Read element properties by index from find_all_elements results.

read_table.summary: Read a grid/table as JSON {headers, rows} (UIA Grid/Table + DevExpress fallback).

realize_virtualized_item.summary: Materialize a virtualized list item via VirtualizedItemPattern.Realize.

release_all.summary: Release target window, caches, highlights, and active event monitors.

repo_action.summary: Execute a QTP/UFT-style Swf* method on a repository object (e.g. Click, Set, Select).

repo_capture.summary: Capture a control into the repository with Swf* class and Smart ID properties (Object Spy style).

repo_find.summary: Resolve a logical object from the UFT-style repository (e.g. frmMain/btnSave).

repo_hints.summary: Get agent hints for a repository object or list hints for the active app.

repo_hints_set.summary: Store or update agent_hints on a repository object (memory for next runs).

repo_list.summary: List objects stored in the repository for the active application.

restore_window.summary: Restore (un-minimize) the target window before UIA interaction.

right_click_element.summary: Right-click a UIA element by automation_id or name.

screenshot.summary: Capture a screenshot of the screen or a region.

screenshot_baseline.summary: Capture a baseline screenshot for later visual comparison.

screenshot_diff.summary: Compare the current screen against the stored baseline.

scroll.summary: Scroll the mouse wheel at a screen position.

scroll_element.summary: Scroll a scrollable container via ScrollPattern (direction/amount or SetScrollPercent).

scroll_into_view.summary: Scroll a list/grid item into view via ScrollItemPattern.ScrollIntoView.

select_control_item.summary: Select a list/combo/grid item by substring match (never set_value on dropdown combos).

select_option.summary: Select ComboBox option by visible text (one-shot).

set_element_value.summary: Set text field value via UIA ValuePattern.

set_target_window.summary: Set or clear the target window for session scope and optional focus policy.

set_value_hwnd.summary: Set value on element scoped to HWND.

smart_find.summary: Find element via layered cascade: repo -> native -> OCR dual -> visual -> agentic.

spy_inspect.summary: Spy-grade full UIA property inspection (40+ fields).

spy_tree.summary: Walk UIA tree with Spy-grade detail.

spy_walk_visible_tool.summary: Walk visible elements highlighting each (Spy-style), paginated.

start_event_monitor.summary: Start monitoring UIA events (focus, structurechanged, propertychanged).

start_watcher.summary: Start watching for new windows, dialogs, and toasts.

stop_event_monitor.summary: Stop one event monitor session (or all if session_id omitted).

take_screenshot_optimized.summary: Screenshot resized to fit an approximate LLM token budget.

type_into_element.summary: Type text into a field found by automation_id or name .

type_text.summary: Type text character by character. For key combos use send_keys instead.

ui_fingerprint.summary: Quick hash of the current UI layout for change detection.

virtual_desktop.summary: Create an isolated virtual desktop so Claude can work without

wait_for_change.summary: Wait until the screen content changes or timeout elapses.

wait_for_condition.summary: Wait until an element property reaches expected_value (semantic verify).

wait_for_element.summary: Wait until a UI element appears (UIA poll). Use after navigation or dialog open.

wait_for_input_idle.summary: Wait until the target window is idle and ready for input (Windows).
